answer.description: Plain-text answer. Put the source after each claim, like [S1]. Say what is missing if only partly answered.

sourceId.description: Id of the source the quote was copied from.

quote.description: ONE contiguous quote, at most 25 words, copied exactly from that source.

citations.description: One entry for each source id cited in the answer; at most 8.

status.description: answered: every part supported. partially_answered: some part unsupported. not_found: nothing in the sources answers it.

followUpQuestions.description: Up to 3 short questions the sources can answer; empty for not_found.
